## Integration
Integration: stack-agnostic spec - springs given as stiffness/damping, timed motions as duration + curve; map every value to your framework and animation library of choice.

## Scene
The "New & Hot" screen: under the header, a horizontal scrolling row of pills - Coming Soon, Everyone's Watching, Top 10 TV Shows, Top 10 Movies. The selected pill is white with dark text; others are dark with light text. Below, a vertical list of title cards (or ranked rows with big numerals for Top 10).

## Motion spec
Pattern: center-scrolling pill tabs with content swap.
- Tap a pill: the bar scrolls horizontally so the tapped pill lands at center (300ms, ease-out), the white selected style sliding from the old pill to the new one (background and text color crossfade, 200ms).
- Pills maintain momentum scrolling with rubber-band edges; selection scroll and user scroll compose - tapping during a manual scroll still centers.
- The list below crossfades to the new category (250ms) with a slight upward drift (12px); ranked categories reveal their large outline numerals with a 40ms-per-row stagger.
- The header and tab bar stay pinned during content swaps.

## Calibration
- Centering must account for pills at the bar's edges - first/last pills center as far as the scroll allows without overshooting the rubber band.
- Only the tapped pill's style changes; hovering/adjacent pills stay put.

## Reduced motion
Instant scroll and crossfade.

## Don't miss
- The white pill is a true pill (full-radius ends), sized to its label with even padding.
- Top 10 rows use oversized outlined numerals beside each card - that ranking typography is the category's signature.
